source.description: Second-floor architectural outline supplied by the project. Section 1 identifies the Grand Ballroom and the toilet; the QR start point is inside the toilet. The plan has no printed scale.

coordinateSystem.conversionRequired: Before using this file for AR navigation, establish a metres-per-pixel scale and a floor-to-marker transform from on-site measurements.

display.layout: Full-screen, portrait. The QR code and distinct asymmetric tracking artwork are one combined sign image.
operatingRequirements: Keep the iPhone fixed and facing into the toilet during Android-phone scanning.
Set brightness to maximum and disable auto-lock for the demonstration.
Do not change the displayed sign image after ARCore image-database calibration.

marker.positionBasis: Sign centre assumed one metre east of the south wall's western/left corner. Using 0.05170 metres per pixel, one metre equals 19.34 pixels from the approximate south-wall corner at [704, 635].

knownDistance.description: Grand Ballroom's shorter outer wall, supplied as 16 metres. The pixel endpoints trace the upper shorter wall of the ballroom on jisik-2f-clean.jpg.

measuredRouteChecks.description: Walkable route from beside the Grand Ballroom's southernmost doorway, along the lower long horizontal corridor, to the eastern hallway end where a room blocks further travel.
measuredRouteChecks.use: Validate and tune the polyline edge lengths after the route is walked. Do not use this value alone as a global metres-per-pixel scale because it represents a route length and includes turns.

requiredInputs: Measured distance between two identifiable points on the physical floor plan
Exact centre point and facing direction of the fixed QR/AR start sign
Measured active display width of the rendered iPhone 13 sign, if it differs from the initial 0.065 m value
Grand Ballroom doorway position verified on site

graph.notes: The active prototype route is toilet-start → toilet-door → main-east → main-centre → main-west → west-to-main → west-lobby. Nodes and edges are an initial visual trace of apparent walkable circulation. Validate every edge and doorway on site before turning this draft into runtime navigation data.
